name: Snake
description: A modern take on the classic Snake game built with vanilla JS and the HTML5 Canvas. Features smooth interpolated movement, progressive difficulty, obstacle waves, particle effects, an online Firebase leaderboard, and a two-player "Simulsnake" expert mode.

name: You Got This
description: A single-page site that greets you with a random, uplifting affirmation on every visit. Built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with no-repeat logic and accessible, screen-reader-friendly markup.

name: Bootstrap 5 Demo
description: An example of a fully responsive website built using the Bootstrap 5 framework. It also makes use of Bootstrap's Javascript library to utilize pop-over windows and collapsible menus for smaller screens.

name: Light/Dark Mode
description: A demo website showcasing a light mode and dark mode using a combination of CSS and Javascript. Also saves which mode was active when the user leaves the site.

name: To-Do List
description: A todo list web app. Allows the user to add tasks to the list, the tasks are separated by whether they are completed or not.

name: Background Color Generator
description: A single HTML page with a button that generates two random colors, then sets the first and second color as the background gradient from left to right.

name: Landing Page
description: A simple example of a landing page.
